The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. In case discounting is not availed by the supplier on TReDS, the tra de receivables will be paid through TReDS as per the payment tim elines indicated in the contract”.
